title: Income and Withholding Tax Data Analyst

cond_0001.intro: A Revenue Tax Specialist Intermediate in the Systems, Support and Discovery Unit will work with a small team of data analysis and tax administration experts to identify compliance work for the Income Tax and Withholding Division. This position's duties include the income tax automated non-filer program. A person in this position must possess strong data analysis abilities and be able to learn and apply new skills. They will work with data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Structured Query Language, and [Company name masked]'s integrated tax system to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers and make work available to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Two (2) years* of full-time professional experience in accounting or auditing
OR
Certification (satisfactory completion of probation) as a Revenue Tax Specialist
An associate degree may substitute for six (6) months of experience. Bachelor's degree may substitute one (1) year of experience; master's degree may substitute for eighteen (18) months of experience; PhD may substitute for twenty-four (24) months of experience. Majors in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Legal, Business Management, Marketing, or other closely related fields are acceptable.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Technical tax knowledge, including court rulings, regulations and administrative policies and procedures
Customer service and interpersonal skills
Ability to plan, direct and review the work of others
Knowledge of personal computer operation and software programs used by the department in its internal and external operations
Communication and presentation skills
Knowledge of audit report processing procedures
Knowledge of electronic filing/processing systems
Skill in reading comprehension
Skill in problem-solving
The ability to gain knowledge and apply it to tax and accounting work
Experience with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel and Structured Query Language (SQL)
Knowledge of federal (Internal Revenue Code) and state statutes, regulations, rulings, and administrative policies related to individual income tax, withholding tax, and property tax refund
Knowledge of withholding tax and income tax nonfiler and audit processes, policies, and procedures
Extensive knowledge of the operation of a personal computer, including the use of Microsoft Office software such as Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint
Physical Requirements
Requires occasional moving of articles such as boxes, accounting records, laptop computer, and portable printer.
Additional Requirements
Prior to an offer of employment, a background check will be conducted. This will include, but is not limited to checking degrees and licensures, criminal history, and tax filing and payment history. All individual income tax filing and payment obligations must be current prior to interviewing for this position.
Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

They will work with data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Structured Query Language, and [Product name masked]'s integrated tax system to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers and make work available to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff.
cond_0183.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 2 years of full-time professional experience in accounting or auditing, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
OR
Certification (satisfactory completion of probation) as a Revenue Tax Specialist
An associate degree may substitute for six (6) months of experience. A bachelor's degree may substitute for one (1) year of experience; a master's degree for eighteen (18) months; a PhD for twenty-four (24) months. Acceptable majors include Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Legal, Business Management, Marketing, or closely related fields.
Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).
Prior to an offer of employment, a background check will be conducted, including degrees and licensures, criminal history, and tax filing and payment history. All individual income tax filing and payment obligations must be current prior to interviewing.
Requires occasional moving of articles such as boxes, accounting records, laptop computer, and portable printer.
Preferred Requirements
Applicants who meet the above requirements will be further evaluated based on the following during the interview process:
Background in accounting and auditing principles and practices
Some exposure to technical tax knowledge, including court rulings, regulations, and administrative policies and procedures
Ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues
Willingness to help plan, direct, and review the work of others
Familiarity with personal computer operation and software programs used in internal and external operations
Comfort with communication and presentation in a professional setting
Familiarity with audit report processing procedures
Some exposure to electronic filing and processing systems
Ability to read and comprehend technical material
Openness to problem-solving and applying new approaches
Willingness to learn and apply knowledge to tax and accounting work
Experience with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel and Structured Query Language (SQL)
Some background in federal (Internal Revenue Code) and state statutes, regulations, rulings, and administrative policies related to individual income tax, withholding tax, and property tax refund
Familiarity with withholding tax and income tax nonfiler and audit processes, policies, and procedures
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software such as Excel, Word, Access, and PowerPoint
cond_0183.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0183.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

They will drive the use of data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Structured Query Language, and [Company name masked]'s integrated tax system to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers, and deliver actionable work to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff.
cond_0215.responsibilities:
Own and execute the income tax automated non-filer program.
Lead data analysis efforts to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers.
Direct the use of data analysis tools including Microsoft Excel, SQL, and [Product name masked] to surface compliance work.
Deliver findings and make work available to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff.
cond_0215.requirements:
Two (2) years* of full-time professional experience in accounting or auditing
OR
Certification (satisfactory completion of probation) as a Revenue Tax Specialist
Applicants who meet the above requirements will be further evaluated based on the following during the interview process:
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Technical tax knowledge, including court rulings, regulations and administrative policies and procedures
Customer service and interpersonal skills
Ability to plan, direct and review the work of others
Knowledge of personal computer operation and software programs used by the department in its internal and external operations
Communication and presentation skills
Knowledge of audit report processing procedures
Knowledge of electronic filing/processing systems
Skill in reading comprehension
Skill in problem-solving
The ability to gain knowledge and apply it to tax and accounting work
Experience with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel and Structured Query Language (SQL)
Knowledge of federal (Internal Revenue Code) and state statutes, regulations, rulings, and administrative policies related to individual income tax, withholding tax, and property tax refund
Knowledge of withholding tax and income tax nonfiler and audit processes, policies, and procedures
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Extensive knowledge of the operation of a personal computer, including the use of Microsoft Office software such as Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint

Bachelor's degree may substitute one (1) year of experience; master's degree may substitute for eighteen (18) months of experience; PhD may substitute for twenty-four (24) months of experience. cond_0294.intro: A Revenue Tax Specialist Intermediate in the Systems, Support and Discovery Unit will work closely with a small team of data analysis and tax administration experts to identify compliance work for the Income Tax and Withholding Division. This position covers the income tax automated non-filer program. You will regularly communicate with colleagues and division staff, using data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Structured Query Language, and [Product name masked] to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers and make work available to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff.
cond_0294.responsibilities:
Work daily with a small team of data and tax experts to identify compliance issues for the Income Tax and Withholding Division
Run and maintain the income tax automated non-filer program
Use data analysis tools including Microsoft Excel, SQL, and [Product name masked] to identify potential non-compliance and non-filers
Communicate findings and make work available to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff
Stay in regular contact with team members to coordinate workload and share results
cond_0294.requirements:

Two (2) years* of full-time professional experience in accounting or auditing, OR certification (satisfactory completion of probation) as a Revenue Tax Specialist
Strong data analysis skills with the ability to learn and apply new tools
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Experience with Microsoft Excel and Structured Query Language (SQL)
Skill in reading comprehension and problem-solving
Ability to communicate findings clearly and handle questions from colleagues
Knowledge of personal computer operation and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint)
Preferred Requirements
Technical tax knowledge, including court rulings, regulations, and administrative policies and procedures
Knowledge of federal (Internal Revenue Code) and state statutes, regulations, rulings, and administrative policies related to individual income tax, withholding tax, and property tax refund
Knowledge of withholding tax and income tax non-filer and audit processes, policies, and procedures
Knowledge of audit report processing procedures and electronic filing/processing systems
Ability to plan, direct, and review the work of others
Customer service and interpersonal skills
Communication and presentation skills, including walking stakeholders through findings and trade-offs
An associate degree may substitute for six (6) months of experience. Bachelor's degree may substitute one (1) year of experience; master's degree may substitute for eighteen (18) months of experience; PhD may substitute for twenty-four (24) months of experience. Requires occasional moving of articles such as boxes, accounting records, laptop computer, and portable printer.

Prior to an offer of employment, a background check will be conducted. This will include, but is not limited to checking degrees and licensures, criminal history, and tax filing and payment history. All individual income tax filing and payment obligations must be current prior to interviewing for this position.

They will work with data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Structured Query Language, and [Company name masked]'s integrated tax system to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers and make work available to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with data analysis and tax administration work.
cond_0563.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Two (2) years* of full-time professional experience in accounting or auditing
OR
Certification (satisfactory completion of probation) as a Revenue Tax Specialist
An associate degree may substitute for six (6) months of experience. Bachelor's degree may substitute one (1) year of experience; master's degree may substitute for eighteen (18) months of experience; PhD may substitute for twenty-four (24) months of experience. Majors in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Legal, Business Management, Marketing, or other closely related fields are acceptable.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Technical tax knowledge, including court rulings, regulations and administrative policies and procedures
Customer service and interpersonal skills
Ability to plan, direct and review the work of others
Knowledge of personal computer operation and software programs used by the department in its internal and external operations
Communication and presentation skills
Knowledge of audit report processing procedures
Knowledge of electronic filing/processing systems
Skill in reading comprehension
Skill in problem-solving
The ability to gain knowledge and apply it to tax and accounting work
Experience with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel and Structured Query Language (SQL)
Knowledge of federal (Internal Revenue Code) and state statutes, regulations, rulings, and administrative policies related to individual income tax, withholding tax, and property tax refund
Knowledge of withholding tax and income tax nonfiler and audit processes, policies, and procedures
Extensive knowledge of the operation of a personal computer, including the use of Microsoft Office software such as Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint
Physical Requirements
Requires occasional moving of articles such as boxes, accounting records, laptop computer, and portable printer.
Additional Requirements
Prior to an offer of employment, a background check will be conducted. This will include, but is not limited to checking degrees and licensures, criminal history, and tax filing and payment history. All individual income tax filing and payment obligations must be current prior to interviewing for this position.
Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

A Revenue Tax Specialist Intermediate in the Systems, Support and Discovery Unit will work closely and regularly with a small team of data analysis and tax administration experts to identify compliance work for the Income Tax and Withholding Division. This position's duties include the income tax automated non-filer program. A person in this position must possess strong data analysis abilities and be able to learn and apply new skills. They will stay in regular contact with colleagues while using data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Structured Query Language, and [Product name masked] to identify potential tax non-compliance and income tax non-filers, and communicate findings to Income Tax and Withholding Division staff.
cond_0573.requirements:
Two (2) years* of full-time professional experience in accounting or auditing
OR
Certification (satisfactory completion of probation) as a Revenue Tax Specialist
Applicants who meet the above requirements will be further evaluated based on the following during the interview process:
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Technical tax knowledge, including court rulings, regulations and administrative policies and procedures
Customer service and interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and handle questions from colleagues
Ability to plan, direct and review the work of others
Knowledge of personal computer operation and software programs used by the department in its internal and external operations
Communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain findings and walk others through results
Knowledge of audit report processing procedures
Knowledge of electronic filing/processing systems
Skill in reading comprehension
Skill in problem-solving
The ability to gain knowledge and apply it to tax and accounting work
Experience with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel and Structured Query Language (SQL)
Knowledge of federal (Internal Revenue Code) and state statutes, regulations, rulings, and administrative policies related to individual income tax, withholding tax, and property tax refund
Knowledge of withholding tax and income tax nonfiler and audit processes, policies, and procedures
Knowledge of accounting and auditing principles and practices
Extensive knowledge of the operation of a personal computer, including the use of Microsoft Office software such as Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint
An associate degree may substitute for six (6) months of experience. Bachelor's degree may substitute one (1) year of experience; master's degree may substitute for eighteen (18) months of experience; PhD may substitute for twenty-four (24) months of experience. Majors in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Legal, Business Management, Marketing, or other closely related fields are acceptable.
Physical Requirements
Requires occasional moving of articles such as boxes, accounting records, laptop computer, and portable printer.
Additional Requirements
Prior to an offer of employment, a background check will be conducted. This will include, but is not limited to checking degrees and licensures, criminal history, and tax filing and payment history. All individual income tax filing and payment obligations must be current prior to interviewing for this position.
Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).
